description: hm-edu shared Renovate defaults: minor/patch/digest automerged as soon as CI is green, majors always need a human, security updates prioritised. No stability window.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security PRs get top priority and run at any time. automerge is deliberately NOT set here: this block is applied after packageRules and would override the no-major rule. Minor/patch security fixes still automerge through the normal rules.

packageRules.description: Pinning the version/digest already in use changes nothing at runtime: automerge (any datasource)
All container images (base, tooling, internal, app): automerge minor/patch/digest
Internal hm-edu Go modules: automerge minor/patch/digest
Go: a major of an INDIRECT dependency changes the module path and cannot be fixed in this repo's go.mod; it must move upstream in the module that requires it
prBodyNotes: :no_entry: This is an **indirect** Go dependency crossing a major (new module path). Changing `go.mod` here is a no-op: `go mod tidy` will restore the old major as long as a direct dependency requires it. Run `go mod why -m <module>` to find the dependent that needs to upgrade, fix it there, then close this PR.

packageRules.description: Database majors: hint about migration steps (never automerged like all majors)
prBodyNotes: :warning: Major database upgrade. Check the data-directory/migration steps (e.g. pg_upgrade, mariadb-upgrade) before merging; the container will not start on the old data directory.
